subject: Re: Redwood trial & infra fit — next steps?
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom@solsticeanalytics.com>, Amy Chen <amy@solsticeanalytics.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood discovery recap + suggested next steps

Hi Tom / Amy —

Great to meet you both today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed plan so we’re all aligned: 

- Top priorities you shared: reduce inference cost on batch pipelines, keep p95 latency under 250ms for interactive dashboards, and centralize model routing across cloud regions.
- Current constraints: two-week procurement window, security review in parallel, on-prem data restrictions for a subset of models.

Proposed next steps (suggested owners):
1) Technical deep-dive + architecture map (SE-run) — Priyom to lead — target week of Oct 4.
2) Pilot outline & success metrics (AE/CS) — Marcus + Laura draft a short SOW and trial plan.
3) Procurement & security checklist — Marcus to send Redwood SOC 2 summary and sample DPA; Solstice to share timeframe.

Action items:
- Tom/Amy: confirm availability for a 60-min deep-dive (Priyom proposed Tue/Wed mornings PT).
- Solstice: attach the MVP requirements doc (I attached the version you shared) and let us know any redlines.

Attachments: solstice-mvp-requirements.pdf

If we can lock a time for the SE call this week we’ll send a short agenda and a pre-read (demo recording and config examples).

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

---
Redwood Inference — Make inference predictable and economical
From: Tom Reynolds <tom@solsticeanalytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood discovery recap + suggested next steps

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear recap.

We’re aligned on priorities. Pricing is the main open item for our execs before we commit to a pilot; can you share a ballpark cost estimate for a 6-week pilot (expected token volumes attached in the doc)? Also interested in any compliance artifacts you can provide sooner rather than later.

I’m available Wed 10/06 AM PT for the SE call. Amy will also join.

—Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of ML Engineering | Solstice Analytics
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom@solsticeanalytics.com>, Amy Chen <amy@solsticeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Checking priority — Redwood pilot estimate + follow-up

Tom / Amy —

Bumping this thread — wanted to make sure our pricing sketch and SOC 2 summary landed with you. Quick notes:
- I attached a short cost worksheet showing expected per-token range for the pilot and a couple of optional routes (quantized vs. full fp16).
- We can offer a small onboarding credit to reduce initial cost while you evaluate perf.

Are you still targeting next week for the SE deep-dive? If priorities shifted I can sync back in a couple weeks — just want to avoid reaching you at a bad time.

If I don’t hear back by Friday I’ll loop the team internally to propose a follow-up cadence.

Thanks,
Marcus
(attachment: redwood-pilot-estimate.xlsx)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: align before second re-contact to Solstice (RDW-20347)

Team —

Haven’t heard back from Tom/Amy after the pricing follow-up on 10/09. Before I send a second re-contact I want us aligned on the ask, risk, and any concessions we’re willing to offer. Please reply briefly with what you’d recommend by EOD:

Quick context:
- Solstice Analytics (prospect) is evaluating Redwood for inference across batch jobs and interactive dashboards.
- They signaled procurement in ~2 weeks but asked for pricing for a 6-week pilot.
- First contact & demo went well; SE deep-dive was tentatively scheduled but not confirmed.

My proposed re-contact plan (short email + calendar nudge):
1) 1-line bump referencing the original thread + restate our ask (confirm SE deep-dive slot or tell us if they want to pause).
2) Offer an explicit 2-week onboarding credit and 2 free hours of SE time if they commit to a pilot in the next 14 days.
3) If still silent after 5 business days, we escalate to a brief note looping in me + Aditya offering an exec check-in to unblock procurement.

Questions for alignment:
- Priyom: can you run a 30-min prep to confirm the deep-dive agenda and identify any red flags we should surface up front?
- Laura: is CS comfortable offering the 2 free hours + onboarding credit? If yes, what language should I use to set expectations?
- Aditya: do you want to approve the above credit range or should I ask for sign-off only if they request discount beyond that?

Proposed outbound copy (short):
"Hi Tom — quick bump on our thread below. Would you be available for a 60-min SE deep-dive next Wed/Thu AM PT? If helpful we can include a 2-week onboarding credit and 2 hours of SE time if you commit to a pilot. If timing’s off, tell me when you’d like us to follow up."

Please reply with a one-line approval or redline. I’ll hold sending until we have consensus.

Thanks — Marcus
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: align before second re-contact to Solstice (RDW-20347)

Marcus —

I’m good to run the 30-min prep. Suggested deep-dive agenda:
- 10m: goals & success metrics (confirm what they measure)
- 20m: infra constraints + demo of model routing (show KV cache scenario)
- 30m: pilot runbook + expected metrics/dialogue for procurement

No major red flags from my side; I’d like their sample payloads beforehand to pick kernels and batching strategy. If we offer the 2-hour SE slot we should make it clear it’s for onboarding only (not a full-run integration).

—Priyom

I can support the onboarding credit and the 2 SE hours as long as we include a short acceptance criteria doc (1 page) that they sign off on before we provision resources. Language: "We’ll apply a one-time onboarding credit equal to two weeks of usage and allocate up to 2 hours of SE time focused on environment setup and validation. This credit is redeemable against pilot usage and is contingent on a mutually agreed pilot scope and schedule."

If they ask for additional discount, escalate to Aditya. Happy to join the outbound email if you want CS presence.

—Laura

Approve the plan. Marcus — you’re authorized to offer the onboarding credit + 2 hours SE. If they request more than a 10% pilot discount route to me. If silent after the second re-contact, I’m happy to do a short executive-check note to help unblock procurement.

—Aditya
